title: NATURAL LIGHT CREATED THE HARDEST-WORKING ROBE IN AMERICA, BUILT FOR BOTH DIY & DOWNTIME
summary: Dropping just in time for the holidays, sitcom star Richard Karn suits up in brand's new workwear-meets-loungewear innovation
body_markdown:
The Utility Robe is making its debut with 90s sitcom star and Natty’s Craft Ambassador, Richard Karn. The DIY legend stars in the launch video, showing off how it helps secure his tools, knock out home projects, and then kick back after a job well done.


**Richard Karn said:** “There’s a point in every project when you put the tools down, look at what you’ve accomplished and decide it’s time to enjoy a Natty. The Utility Robe was created for that exact moment. You can get your hands dirty, finish up the work, and head straight into relaxation mode without the hassle of an outfit change. That’s my kind of efficiency.”


**Krystyn Stowe, Head of Marketing Busch Family & Natural Family, Anheuser-Busch** said: “Natural Light fans take pride in getting things done, but they’re equally serious about kicking back afterward. If there’s someone on your holiday list who would always rather be in the garage, we made the perfect gift for them. The Utility Robe gives them one uniform for both that works as hard as they do.”


As the go-to beer brand for workshop warriors and DIY enthusiasts, Natty’s Utility Robe is the next evolution of that obsession: a novel uniform that works just as well in the garage as it does on the couch. The Utility Robe comes after Natty’s viral 2025 holiday gift,[Garageflage](https://www.anheuser-busch.com/newsroom/natural-light-garageflage) , a head-to-toe clothing line featuring prints of garage environments so fans could disappear into their garage during the holiday chaos. Earlier this year, Natural Light also became the[Official Sponsor](https://www.anheuser-busch.com/newsroom/NaturalLight-Official-Sponsor) of one lucky fan’s garage, transforming it with stadium-inspired upgrades and buying the garage’s naming rights. The Natural Light Utility Robe will be available November 17 for $49.99, with free shipping, on NaturalLight.com/UtilityRobe. Help them relax hard and give the DIYer on your list something they’ll actually use, or grab one for yourself. Just don’t wait too long or you might find yourself wrapping another pair of socks.
